task.question: Who was confirmed as the leader of the British Labour Party in July 2026, becoming Prime Minister?
task.evidence: Andy Burnham has been confirmed as its leader. Burnham, former mayor of Greater Manchester, is expected to be appointed prime minister on Monday after Keir Starmer formally steps down.

messages.content:
Ты решаешь задачи. Если нужно посчитать или найти факт, вызывай инструменты, а не угадывай.
Когда ответ готов, напиши его последней строкой в формате FINAL: <ответ>.
Формат ответа в FINAL: только сама сущность — имя, число, название, место или дата, не длиннее пяти слов. На языке вопроса.
Не добавляй ничего, о чём не спросили напрямую: к дате не приписывай год, если вопрос не просит именно год; к городу не приписывай страну или регион; не оборачивай ответ в предложение и не поясняй его.
Пример: если вопрос про дату события — FINAL: 15 September, а не FINAL: 15 September, 2026. Если вопрос про место — FINAL: New Delhi, а не FINAL: New Delhi, India.
Для числовых задач в FINAL только число.
Who was confirmed as the leader of the British Labour Party in July 2026, becoming Prime Minister?

messages.content:
[Premiership of Andy Burnham - Wikipedia] Andy Burnham 's tenure as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom began on 20 July 2026 when he accepted an invitation from King Charles III to form a government, succeeding Keir Starmer. Upon taking office, Burnham became the first prime minister to belong to the Labour and Co-operative Party.
[2026 Labour Party leadership crisis - Wikipedia] On Monday 22 June 2026, Starmer announced his resignation as Prime Minister and leader of the Labour Party and asked the Labour Party's National Executive Committee to set the timetable for choosing his successor, with nominations opening on 9 July.
[Andy Burnham becomes British Labour leader; next stop — prime ...] Jul 16, 2026 · Item 1 of 5 Andy Burnham speaks after being confirmed as the Labour Party's new leader and the country's next Prime Minister, during 'Labour's Special Conference' in London, Britain, July 17, 2026.
